title: MxAgile Platform Boundaries
description: Canonical schema for the platform boundaries manifest. Located at planning/platform-boundaries.yaml. Declares which functionalities are delivered by platform modules rather than the application itself, and what rules apply to them during UI parity, discovery, and acceptance. See WP-10 and policies/mockup-lifecycle.md § Platform Boundary Scope Rule.

id.description: Stable identifier for this boundary, e.g. PLATFORM-MB-SSO.

provider.description: Name of the platform module or external system providing this functionality, e.g. MB_SSO.

responsibilities.description: List of functional responsibilities delivered by this platform module. E.g. ['authentication', 'password-management', 'session-management'].

mockup_behavior.description: Rules for how this boundary is represented in mockups. E.g. 'no productive login screen', 'demo role switcher is test-only'.

parity_rule.description: EXCLUDE_FROM_UI_PARITY: screens owned by this platform module are not verified in app UI parity campaigns. INCLUDE_IN_UI_PARITY: platform-provided screens ARE verified (rare). VERIFY_NAVIGATION_ONLY: only verify that navigation to/from this boundary works correctly.

implementation_rule.description: REUSE_PLATFORM_MODULE: use the module as-is. EXTEND_PLATFORM_MODULE: use the module with an extension (do not fork the original). IMPLEMENT_SEPARATELY: boundary is the application's own responsibility.

role_source_rule.description: How roles defined by this boundary relate to fachliche roles. E.g. 'business roles remain independently relevant regardless of MB_SSO authentication'.

modification_rule.description: Whether agents and developers may modify this platform module.

excluded_screens.description: PAGE-NNN identifiers of screens that belong to this platform boundary and are excluded from fachliche scope.

decision_ref.description: DEC-NNN that formally confirmed this platform boundary decision.

status.description: CONFIRMED: boundary decision is final and authoritative. PROPOSED: boundary is proposed but not yet confirmed. UNDER_REVIEW: boundary decision is being reconsidered.

notes.description: Optional additional context for this platform boundary.
